context: Guards the debugging heuristic: when a user names a redirect destination (/company/404.html), the agent should reason about whether that destination resolves and identify the company-prefixed 404 redirect as the loop, rather than tracing the whole auth/login flow first. Fixture index.js has the buggy company-prefixed 404 redirect.

checklist.name: Identifies the 404 destination as unprovisioned / looping
checklist.description: The agent explains that /volkswagen/404.html itself 404s (404.html is a shared root static file, not copied per-company) so the redirect re-triggers the handler — an infinite loop.

checklist.name: Pinpoints the company-prefixed 404 redirect as the bug
checklist.description: The agent names cloudflare/src/index.js redirectToBasePath(request, '/404.html') (prefixing BASE on the shared 404 page) as the root cause.

checklist.name: Checks the destination before over-tracing auth
checklist.description: The agent reasons about the named destination (/volkswagen/404.html) resolving, rather than spending the investigation on the auth callback, Referer header, or cookies before considering the destination.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer (I1).
